id: title:Gilbert09:raise clearly when an oauth integration secret is still encrypted

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a runtime check and exception to prevent sending unencrypted ciphertext as OAuth credentials, potentially preventing credential reuse or misconfiguration errors.

P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 implement a check against the ciphertext prefix and raise an exception if the stored secret is still ciphertext. P1.F2.H1 updates tests. observations.behavior: Adds a marker and a helper to detect if a stored secret is still encrypted ciphertext.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks the stored credential against the Fernet ciphertext prefix before sending it to an OAuth provider, preventing sending a ciphertext as a credential.

observations.behavior: Wraps the retrieval of OAuth tokens to check for ciphertext and raise an error if detected.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the access_token and refresh_token properties to raise UndecryptedIntegrationSecretError if the stored value still looks like ciphertext, rather than returning the ciphertext as the credential.

observations.behavior: Adds the new exception to the test imports.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows tests to use the new exception for OAuth token retrieval checks.
